issue_context.title: Support Label configurations for TiDB
issue_context.body:
## Feature Request

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...] -->
To support auto-scaling in PD, PD needs to organize the each instances by groups in the cluster. The current way to marking the several instances as a group is to mark them with the same group label.

For TiKV, If Store 1 and Store 2 both have the same label `group=A`, then PD will think them as one group. As TiKV already have metapb.StoreLabel to handle the label logic, TiDB currently haven't the similar logic to handle it.

**Describe the feature you'd like:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. -->
As we don't need to update label during runtime in auto-scaling, one simple way to archive this target is to add the labels configuration and make it register into PD etcd by `TopoInfoSyncer`, then PD could visit the etcd and get each TiDB instance's label information.


**Describe alternatives you've considered:**
<!-- A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered. -->
Add a new configuration `labels` and its type is `map[string]string`. For `TopoInfoSyncer` will also sync the label information into PD etcd.  That's all.


**Teachability, Documentation, Adoption, Migration Strategy:**
<!-- If you can, explain some scenarios how users might use this, situations it would be helpful in. Any API designs, mockups, or diagrams are also helpful. -->
comments:
> To support auto-scaling in PD, PD needs to organize the each instances by groups in the cluster. The current way to marking the several instances as a group is to mark them with the same group label.

Can you expand the details why the auto-scaling need group instances first?

> why the auto-scaling need group instances

I think explaining would be off-topic for this issue, so I added the comment here instead of updating the description. @lonng 

The direct reason PD needs to group the instances in auto-scaling case is to directly mapping the instances in cloud (for tidb-operator, the heterogeneous cluster are managed by different groups/ for tidb cloud, the machine resources are managed by different machine type groups) which would be clear to cover the whole auto-scaling process in cloud.

Moreover, I think support label configuration for TiDB may also be helpful for other cases like follower read(tidb could directly read the specific tikv if they are in the same group). As auto-scaling is one of the user-cases for grouping instances (also the most needed in near future) and group instances is also the one of the user-cases after label configuration is supported, supporting label configuration would be helpful in many cases especially relating to the scheduling.

> group instances is also the one of the user-cases after label configuration is supported

would the tidb-servers in the same group share the same configuration?

@zz-jason No, they won't. Label is the independent component in the configuration and only PD will organize them into groups, but I think in real user cases (like tidb-cloud), they may(as user manually keep the same configuration in one group).
I mark this feature request as accepted. Let's move on to the technical design progress.
@zz-jason  I think the design will be very simple and I updated the alternatives in the description.
